name: Australia, House of Representatives election
summary: Retrospective replay from the AEC's own election-night count (365 messages, polling place by polling place). Of 41 questions, 17 were already at 90% or more on the right answer before the count, including the $8.6M prime minister market. On the 24 contested questions the model reached 90% on the right answer first on 21, the market first on 0, a median 109 minutes earlier. But it was too sure of itself: its 90% range for Labor's seats held 10% of the time.
